headline: Waymo says Singapore will be its next international robotaxi city
summary: Waymo plans to launch a robotaxi service in Singapore by 2028. Vehicles will arrive in coming months for mapping and testing. Autonomous testing with safety drivers will commence in 2027.

headline: The AI Superintelligence Slowdown
summary: Tech leaders are now advocating for a slower, more cautious approach to AI development. The previous 'move fast and break things' mentality is shifting. Concerns over rogue AI agents and safety are driving this change.

headline: Claude Code relaunches Projects to manage multiple AI agents in the cloud
summary: Claude Code's revamped Projects feature allows users to manage multiple AI agents collaboratively. Agents within a project share memory, goals, and a library of files. A 'coordinator' directs various parallel 'threads' performing tasks.

headline: Save $30 or more on a refurbished Apple TV 4K
summary: Despite rising hardware prices, refurbished Apple TV 4K models offer significant savings. The 64GB model is available for $169, saving buyers $30 off the new retail price. Purchasing refurbished directly from Apple helps offset increased costs.

headline: First Plot Details for Zack Snyder's Escape from New York Remake
summary: Zack Snyder revealed initial plot details for his 'Escape from New York' remake. He discussed the setting of the highly anticipated film. Snyder also hinted at having a star already lined up to play Snake Plissken.

headline: Magic's Most-Wanted Marvel Deck Is Discounted – Here's Why You Should Consider This One Instead
summary: The MTG Marvel Doom Prevails Commander deck is currently discounted on Amazon. However, the 'Avengers Assemble' deck offers superior gameplay value for less money. Players are advised to consider 'Avengers Assemble' for a better overall experience.

headline: Resident Evil Ending Explained
summary: Zach Cregger's 'Resident Evil' movie has premiered and left many questions. The article provides a detailed explanation of the film's conclusion. It also explores potential post-credits scenes and their implications for the franchise's future.

headline: Save Up to 90% Off PC Games During Ubisoft's 40th Anniversary Sale, Plus Get One Game Totally Free
summary: Ubisoft is celebrating its 40th anniversary with a massive PC game sale. Gamers can save up to 90% on various titles, with many games priced at just two dollars. The anniversary sale also includes one free game for customers.

headline: Twenty women had breasts removed unnecessarily during cancer treatment, NHS trust admits
summary: An NHS trust in north-east England admitted 20 women underwent unnecessary mastectomies. These women were among hundreds harmed by faulty cancer treatment at the trust. The admissions highlight severe medical errors and patient suffering.

headline: 'I've been butchered': Women speak of trauma after unnecessary mastectomies
summary: Women are sharing their traumatic experiences after undergoing unnecessary mastectomies. An NHS trust in north-east England confirmed 20 such cases. The admissions highlight profound medical negligence and its devastating impact on patients.

headline: War may be coming. Are we psychologically ready?
summary: Military and government officials warn of a growing risk of international conflict. The article questions whether the public is psychologically prepared for potential warfare. It highlights the mental health challenges associated with impending conflict.

headline: Met was negligent and reckless, sisters of 'Putney pusher' suspect tell BBC
summary: The sisters of Nicholas Brandram claim the Met Police acted negligently and recklessly. They assert Brandram was innocent of the 'Putney pusher' incident. His family believes immense pressure from the allegations led him to take his own life.
